laptex3.note: It is a texture atlas: separate parts of one object laid side by side on one sheet. Every part stays exactly where it is, with its outline, size and colour. They are the parts of a black portable computer, its keyboard turned a quarter turn. The plain blue rectangle is its screen, switched on: an abstract 2070s Matrix view, a glowing cyan and amber lattice of connected nodes on near-black. No symbol, no readable words.

laptop_01.note: It is a texture atlas: separate parts of one object laid side by side on one sheet. Every part stays exactly where it is, with its outline, size and colour. They are the parts of a black portable computer: its lid, its underside, its screen at the upper right and its keyboard below the screen. The plain blue rectangle is the screen. It is switched on and shows a 2070s Matrix work desktop, the kind a megacorporation wage slave uses: near-black graphite background, thin cyan and amber outlines, floating translucent windows with a node network graph, a wireframe city block, small bar charts and columns of tiny abstract unreadable text, and a slim bar of plain geometric icons along the bottom edge. No landscape photo, no operating system logo, no readable words.

mdrnw2wcp_12.note: It is a muted teal green office carpet with a woven basket pattern of crossing bands of parallel ribs. The same pattern in the same places.

monitor_01.note: It is a texture atlas: separate parts of one object laid side by side on one sheet. Every part stays exactly where it is, with its outline, size and colour. They are the parts of a dark flat monitor: its back, its side, a plain panel, its foot, and its front at the lower right. The plain blue rectangle is the screen of the front. It is switched on and shows a 2070s tactical map: dark background, a cyan wireframe city district seen from above, thin amber sensor sweeps and small markers. No readable words.
